array_layout: All time series use [control_step, selected_case, ...]; case_indices maps to results.json cases.
validity: Use active_before_step. It includes the first ended sample; later samples for that case are invalid.
sample_time: Post-control-step state; time_s starts at 0.02 s. command_body is the command issued before that step.

frames.root_pos_relative_w_m: Root link position minus its initial world position; world XYZ axes.
frames.root_quat_wxyz: Root world quaternion, scalar-first [w, x, y, z].
frames.root_link_lin_vel_w_mps: Root link-origin linear velocity in world XYZ.
frames.root_lin_vel_b_mps: Existing articulation root COM linear velocity in body XYZ.
frames.root_ang_vel_w_rad_s: Root angular velocity in world XYZ.
frames.root_ang_vel_b_rad_s: Root angular velocity in body XYZ.
frames.wheel_pos_relative_w_m: Wheel body origins minus initial root position; world XYZ axes, not contact points.
frames.wheel_pos_root_relative_w_m: Wheel body origins minus current root position; world XYZ axes, not body axes.
frames.wheel_contact_force_norm_n: Norm of contact_forces.data.net_forces_w for the matching wheel body; last physics substep, not a substep maximum.
frames.command_body: [vx m/s, vy m/s, wz rad/s] in body coordinates.

termination_values: Unmodified termination_manager.get_term values at each control step; columns follow termination_term_names.
termination_reasons: results.json stores each raw term at the case's first termination/truncation/4 m exit; absent required terms are false and not in termination_term_names.
substep_caution: These traces sample at 50 Hz. Original joints maxima/counters in results.json retain all active 200 Hz substeps, including spikes absent from control samples.
